experiment: microbatch geometry at constant global batch 64 x 2048 = 131072 tokens
protocol: one process per (arm, microbatch); accumulation 64/B steps; one clip + step per update; warmups before timing; peak memory recorded

results.status: contaminated by preceding dense-mb2 thrash; kept as provenance
not run: extrapolated ~8 GiB peak (thrash territory)

comparison_A_matched_geometry.note: dense mb2 is unusable (memory thrash), so this ratio is not a fair matched-geometry claim

comparison_B_best_feasible.note: sparse memory headroom permits a geometry dense cannot fit on 8 GiB; directional only for G4

verified.sparse_mb1_anomaly_resolved: 10.2 s -> 3.46 s in a clean process; the slow number followed a dense memory-thrash run and is clock/state contamination
verified.dense_mb2_collapse: 7.79 GiB of 8.19 GiB triggers allocator slowdown; dense cannot use mb2 locally

inferred.g4_projection: cannot be projected reliably from local 8 GiB geometry-limited results; requires the G4 transfer package at production B16x4
inferred.local_vs_one_hour: best local 46.7k tok/s = 6.7% of the 694k tok/s one-hour rate; the remaining gap is floor work (copies, writer, launch tax), not expert arithmetic

decision: PROMOTE microbatch geometry as a real systems component; local optimum at sparse mb2
next: B3 copy/materialization attack and B4 writer decomposition; then stack microbatch + floor wins and re-measure
